messages:
selena_cs: Quick heads-up from three recent onboards: customers are surprised by 'overage protection' and where cost-alert thresholds live. One trial account flagged as renewal-risk because they expected automatic alerts. Need a fast capture path so we can send into product triage.

matt_enablement: Seen this on two enablement calls too. People expect a clear toggle and email preview. Would help if capture distinguishes "missing alert" vs "confusing label".

david_product: Agreed. Minimal capture modal idea: org + contact, symptom (one-line), expected vs actual, was there an email alert? yes/no, account tier (trial/paying), suggested priority. Also attach screenshot.

zara_eng: For engineering, add deployment type and any sample request id. If account id provided we can pull recent spikes and attach limited logs. I can add the diagnostic flag to webhook.

selena_cs: Draft modal copy: 
```
Symptom: 
Org / contact: 
Expected: 
Actual: 
Alert sent? yes / no / not sure
Account tier: trial / paid
Frequency: once / repeated
Attach: screenshot / link
Suggested urgency: low / med / high
```

matt_enablement: Perfect. I'll tell CSMs to use it in calls tomorrow. If we can auto-tag as "onboard-cost-alerts" that helps routing.

support_bot: Capture created: CAPT-2026-900 "Cost alert not firing for trial" submitted by selena_cs. Link: https://tracker.internal/CAPT-2026-900

david_product: I'll slot a 15m triage today. If we get 3+ similar reports with "overage protection" phrasing within a week, we schedule a micro-UX fix.

zara_eng: Building the Slack shortcut + webhook now. @selena_cs please DM a test account id so I can exercise the diagnostic attach.

selena_cs: Sent test id. Thanks team
